title: TokenDeployedEvent
description: Published when a token deployment is confirmed. Unified schema matching GraphQL `tokenDeployed` subscription payload expectations for proper tenant scoping and filtering.

creatorAddress.description: Stellar/Soroban address of the token creator. Used for tenant scoping in subscriptions.

totalSupply.description: Total supply of the token. Stringified bigint (string) or raw bigint depending on the publisher.

txHash.description: Transaction hash or batch deployment identifier for traceability.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event was published.
